map.💡 选型原则：磨料硬度须高于工件硬度 1.5 倍以上；硬度越高越需选高硬度磨料（: 💡 Selection principle: abrasive hardness must exceed the workpiece by over 1.5×; the harder the workpiece, the higher-hardness abrasive needed (alumina → silicon carbide → CBN → diamond).

map.算法：输入可为 HV 或 HRC，HRC 按对照表线性插值换算为 HV（20HR: Algorithm: input may be HV or HRC; HRC is linearly interpolated to HV by the table (20HRC=238HV, 45HRC=461HV, 55HRC=595HV, 60HRC=697HV, 68HRC=940HV); then HV back-solves an approximate HRC. HV bands: <300 mild/annealed steel, 300~600 quenched steel (<50HRC), 600~900 high-carbon/tool steel (55~65HRC), 900~1500 carbide/super-hard steel (>65HRC), >1500 ceramic/super-hard; within a band, rough/fine/polish gives abrasive type, grit, and wheel speed.
map.例：600HV、粗磨 → 反算约 55.2HRC，判为「高碳/工具钢（55~65: Example: 600HV, rough → back-solve ~55.2HRC, judged high-carbon/tool steel (55~65HRC), recommend chrome alumina PA / monocrystalline alumina SA, grit F36~F46, speed 20~30 m/s. Input 60HRC (697HV), fine → recommend monocrystalline alumina SA / cubic boron nitride CBN, grit F60~F100, speed 25~35 m/s. 1600HV, rough → judged ceramic/super-hard, only diamond D, grit F80~F120, speed 15~25 m/s.
map.为什么高硬度材料要用 CBN 或金刚石？: Why use CBN or diamond for high-hardness materials?
map.磨料硬度必须显著高于工件才能有效切削。刚玉类磨料加工 65HRC 以上（约 85: The abrasive must be far harder than the workpiece to cut effectively. Alumina grains dull rapidly on >65HRC (~850HV) materials; CBN and diamond keep sharpness and wheel life, and despite higher unit price the total cost is lower.
map.粒度号 F 和 W 有什么区别？: What is the difference between F and W grit?
map.F 为固结磨具用粒度（数字越大越细），W 为微粉粒度（数字越小越细）。粗磨常用: F is the bonded-abrasive grit (larger number = finer), W is micro-powder grit (larger number = coarser). Rough grinding commonly F24~F46, fine F60~F150, polishing the W series micro-powder (e.g. W14, W7).
